data.exact_reserve_text:
Favourable runoff experience and reserve releases in the year across all classes except the Political Risk and Director & Officers classes

Strengthening of Political Risk reserves as a consequence of specific adverse experience and a reevaluation of reserves in the light of the deterioration in global economic conditions which occurred during 2020.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 114.931m. During 2020 there was a small net prior-year release of approximately GBP 0.816m (about 0.71% of opening reserves), driven by favourable run-off and reserve releases across most classes partially offset by reserve strengthening in Political Risk and Directors & Officers attributable to adverse experience and deterioration in global economic conditions during 2020.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable runoff experience and reserve releases in the year across all classes except the Political Risk and Director & Officers classes

Strengthening of Political Risk reserves as a consequence of specific adverse experience and a reevaluation of reserves in the light of the deterioration in global economic conditions which occurred during 2020.

The 2018 YOA result has improved by 9.3% in calendar year 2020, notwithstanding strengthening of reserves in respect of unexpired political risk policies exposed to worsening global economic conditions.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims by underwriting year) on page 31. No single explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was provided; the triangle was used to compute per-year changes and summed. There is RITC/closure activity referenced for the 2018 year which may affect interpretation of closed-year results, but the triangle values used are explicit gross cumulative claims. LOB mappings are approximate (report uses regulatory class names; these were mapped to standard Lloyd's LOBs where possible).
